meta: A 15-minute home workout with no equipment: even busy people can ask AI for a session that fits them.

muc.title: Fifteen minutes at home
muc.text: No gym or equipment needed: AI can still plan a 15-minute home workout for you.

muc.title: Explain your limits
muc.text: Tell AI your age, how active you are and old injuries like knee pain, so it avoids exercises that don't suit you.

muc.title: Start really easy
muc.text: Ask AI to split the session into warm-up, main workout and stretching, very easy in the first week, then build up.

muc.title: Stop if it hurts
muc.text: If you feel pain, dizziness or shortness of breath, stop right away and see a doctor.

muc.title: Tonight's workout
muc.text: Tell AI when you're free and where it hurts, ask for a 15-minute living-room workout, and try it tonight.

thu: Tell AI when you're free and where it hurts, ask for a 15-minute living-room workout, and try it tonight.
